prompt: A client installs DIRCM-based missile protection systems on in-production FAA type-certificated airliners. Which export control regime covers the modified aircraft after October 2026, and which covers the protection equipment?
assertions: States survivability-enhanced aircraft moved off USML Category VIII(a)(8) effective October 13, 2026 (interim final rule, 91 FR 55457)
States the modified aircraft are now subject to the EAR (Commerce jurisdiction)
States the secured aircraft survivability equipment itself (DIRCM plus associated IR/UV missile warning with anti-tamper) remains on the USML in Category XI(a)(4)
Mentions the conditions: in-production manned civil aircraft with FAA transport/commuter type certificate or NATO/MNNA equivalent, with definitions added at 22 CFR 121.0
Does not assert that the rule assigned a specific destination ECCN (the rule names none)
